name: Medical Pulse
tagline: Clean white clinic canvas with teal gradient bar, mint metric cards, ECG line and a red cross accent (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: white ground, navy text, cyan-to-mint accents, one red alert color

typography.style: tight geometric sans headlines with mono instrument-style labels

best_for: Medical, biotech, wellness and any science-led product where credibility and cleanliness matter. Strong for metric-heavy summaries with four clear numbers.
avoid_for: Playful, artistic or luxury topics where the clinical grid would feel cold.
